It features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metallic pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center creating a stepped silhouette. Below the pipes is a decorative wooden case with carved details and a console area, though the keyboards and pedalboard are not clearly visible from this angle. The organ is flanked by dark curtains.

The carved details on the central wooden section below the main pipe array appear somewhat indistinct and 'mushy,' lacking the crisp edges of real wood carving. The geometry of the small archway/niche seems slightly asymmetrical and ill-defined.
The line where the organ case meets the ceiling/wall on the right side appears slightly warped or inconsistent with the straight lines of the architecture on the left.
